title: Nicolet Beach Rentals

services.name: E-Bikes
services.desc: The Sunset Trail is perfect for beginners, offering 5.1 miles of graveled paths with stunning views that provide a wonderful tour through the State Park. The Sunset Trail features a mix of hills and flat terrain and takes you past notable landmarks like the boat launch, Eagle Bluff Lighthouse, and Sven's Bluff. It leads all the way to Fish Creek and passes by the Nature Center. Remember that the Sunset Bike Trail is gravel and not designed for high-speed travel. It can become soft when wet and may erode during heavy rains. services.name: Kayak
services.desc: You can bring your own boat, or rent a single kayak or double kayak from Nicolet Beach Rentals. Kayak rentals are available by the hour, allowing you to tailor your adventure to your schedule and interests. Coordination is key if you rent a double kayak; paddling with your partner will make your journey smoother. A single kayak can be more manageable for families with small children or pets, with the little ones sitting between your legs. A trip to Eagle Bluff is highly recommended for those looking to rent a kayak for just one hour. This nearby natural wonder provides breathtaking views of cliffs, caves, and local wildlife. services.name: Paddleboard
services.desc: Let's start with the first steps: launch and standing. It's simpler than it sounds. First, prepare the board by bringing it into water deep enough that the fin doesn't touch the ground. Place your hands near the handle to mount the board and lift one knee at a time onto the board. It's always helpful to have someone steady the board while you mount.
